integrity: Proof is analytic. Standalone finite checks are consistency tests, not certification of universally quantified or asymptotic statements; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact support-size constants are proved for 2 through 6 only; higher support sizes have a sharp linear asymptotic and explicit upper bound, without fixed-coordinate asymptotics or complete equality classification. Priority risk: an unindexed earlier evaluation of the same cyclic Fourier quotient.
title: Four-state robustness and sharp high-support growth for Efron–Stein telescoping
